summary: The compliance review of the product 'RupeeRush: Instant Personal Loans' identified multiple gaps against the reviewed RBI rules. The key findings include: (1) Imposing a penalty for exiting during the cooling-off period, which is not allowed under DLD2025:10(i). (2) Charging a ₹199 'credit insights subscription' to every EMI after disbursal without disclosure in the KFS and without borrower consent, violating DLD2025:9(iv) and KFS2024:8. (3) Lack of provisions for data consent management as per DLD2025:12(ii). (4) Failure to provide a Key Fact Statement (KFS) as required under DLD2025:8(i). (5) Non-compliance with direct disbursement into the borrower's bank account under DLD2025:9(i). (6) Absence of provisions for direct execution of loan servicing and repayment in the RE’s bank account without third-party involvement under DLD2025:9(ii) and (iii).
